principle: Concrete match, squad, competition, offer, leadership and contract-clause claims must come from an authoritative shared surface. Aggregate form, reputation, age, role, month and narrative flags are not substitutes.

upstreamReview.resultFor30_34: The new persisted weekly match model materially improves fixture/squad authority but does not prove a cup/continental final, two high-intensity starts inside 72 hours, recent goals, crowd response, national-team preselection, multi-offer persistence, a minutes-based renewal clause, or a quantified 30-34 locker-weight threshold. Previous EVT_31_FINAL_001 and EVT_33_BODY_001 existence-only sport gates are therefore reclassified as partial/insufficient rather than protected fail-closed gates.

implementationRules: No generic sport gate may be added solely to make a test pass.
No missing match fact may be replaced by sport.form, roleScore, age, reputation, coach trust, month, seasonDay or a narrative flag.
A scheduled league fixture is not evidence of a cup/continental final.
Existence of nextFixture/hoursToNextFixture is not evidence of two starts inside 72 hours.
No multi-offer scene may be certified from MarketState.pending or from getEligibleCareerOffers while persistence remains single-offer.
No contractual clause may be claimed as authoritative if CareerTerms cannot persist it.
No canonical LOCKER_WEIGHT threshold may be inferred from professional.lockerPower or an arbitrary NPC relationship scalar.
Authority gaps remain technical-adaptation debt, not aliases or verified identity.
